verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·lə·ḏō·wṯ ‘ê·śāw hū ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: This is the account of Esau (that is Edom)
verses.literalPt: E ESTAS são as gerações de Esaú (que é Edom).

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת־ נָשָׁ֖יו מִבְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת־ עָדָ֗ה בַּת־ אֵילוֹן֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־ אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת־ עֲנָ֔ה בַּת־ צִבְע֖וֹן הַֽחִוִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- nā·šāw mib·bə·nō·wṯ kə·nā·‘an ’eṯ- ‘ā·ḏāh baṯ- ’ê·lō·wn ha·ḥit·tî wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh baṯ- ‘ă·nāh baṯ- ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn ha·ḥiw·wî
verses.literal: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite
verses.literalPt: Esaú tomou suas mulheres das filhas de Canaã; a Ada, filha de Elom, heteu, e a Aolibama, filha de Aná, filho de Zibeão, heveu.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲח֥וֹת נְבָיֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bā·śə·maṯ baṯ- yiš·mā·‘êl ’ă·ḥō·wṯ nə·ḇā·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: and Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth
verses.literalPt: E a Basemate, filha de Ismael, irmã de Nebaiote.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־ אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־ רְעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ ‘ā·ḏāh lə·‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lî·p̄āz ū·ḇā·śə·maṯ yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- rə·‘ū·’êl
verses.literal: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau Basemath gave birth to Reuel
verses.literalPt: E Ada teve de Esaú a Elifaz; e Basemate teve a Reuel;

verses.original: וְאָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת־ יְעִישׁ וְאֶת־ יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־ קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ־ ל֖וֹ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- yə·ʿīš wə·’eṯ- ya‘·lām wə·’eṯ- qō·raḥ ’êl·leh bə·nê ‘ê·śāw ’ă·šer yul·lə·ḏū- lōw bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush Jalam and Korah These were the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: E Aolibama deu à luz a Jeús, Jalão e Coré; estes são os filhos de Esaú, que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת־ נָ֠שָׁיו וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְאֶת־ מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בְּהֶמְתּ֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- nā·šāw wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·ṯāw wə·’eṯ- kāl- nap̄·šō·wṯ bê·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- miq·nê·hū wə·’eṯ- kāl- bə·hem·tōw wə·’êṯ kāl- qin·yā·nōw ’ă·šer rā·ḵaš bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an way·yê·leḵ ’el- ’e·reṣ mip·pə·nê ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: Later, Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household along with his livestock all his other animals and all the property he had acquired in Canaan and he moved to . . . a land far away from his brother Jacob
verses.literalPt: E Esaú tomou suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas filhas, e todas as almas de sua casa, e seu gado, e todos os seus animais, e todos os seus bens, que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã; e foi para outra terra apartando-se de Jacó, seu irmão;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yāh rə·ḵū·šām rāḇ miš·še·ḇeṯ yaḥ·dāw wə·lō yā·ḵə·lāh ’e·reṣ mə·ḡū·rê·hem lā·śêṯ ’ō·ṯām mip·pə·nê miq·nê·hem
verses.literal: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock
verses.literalPt: Porque os bens deles eram muitos para habitarem juntos; e a terra de suas peregrinações não os podia sustentar por causa do seu gado.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ ‘ê·śāw bə·har śê·‘îr ‘ê·śāw hū ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: So Esau . . . (that is Edom settled in the area of Mount Seir
verses.literalPt: Portanto Esaú habitou na montanha de Seir; Esaú é Edom.

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·lə·ḏō·wṯ ‘ê·śāw ’ă·ḇî ’ĕ·ḏō·wm bə·har śê·‘îr
verses.literal: This is the account of Esau the father of the Edomites in the area of Mount Seir
verses.literalPt: Estas, pois, são as gerações de Esaú, pai dos edomeus, na montanha de Seir.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן־ עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן־ בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- ‘ê·śāw ’ĕ·lî·p̄az ben- ‘ā·ḏāh ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw rə·‘ū·’êl ben- bā·śə·maṯ ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: These are the names of Esau’s sons Eliphaz son of Esau’s wife Adah and Reuel son of Esau’s wife Basemath
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, filho de Ada, mulher de Esaú; Reuel, filho de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אוֹמָ֔ר צְפ֥וֹ וְגַעְתָּ֖ם וּקְנַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·p̄āz tê·mān ’ō·w·mār ṣə·p̄ōw wə·ḡa‘·tām ū·qə·naz
verses.literal: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman Omar Zepho Gatam and Kenaz
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Elifaz foram: Temã, Omar, Zefô, Gaetã e Quenaz.

verses.original: וְתִמְנַ֣ע׀ הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽאֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן־ עֵשָׂ֔ו וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֶאֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯim·na‘ hā·yə·ṯāh p̄î·le·ḡeš le·’ĕ·lî·p̄az ben- ‘ê·śāw wat·tê·leḏ le·’ĕ·lî·p̄az ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq ’êl·leh bə·nê ‘ā·ḏāh ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: Additionally, Timna . . . a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz gave birth to Amalek - These are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah
verses.literalPt: E Timna era concubina de Elifaz, filho de Esaú, e teve de Elifaz a Amaleque. Estes são os filhos de Ada, mulher de Esaú.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָזֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּמִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּ֣ה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh bə·nê rə·‘ū·’êl na·ḥaṯ wā·ze·raḥ šam·māh ū·miz·zāh ʾēl·lɛh hā·yū bə·nê ḇā·śə·maṯ ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: These are the sons of Reuel Nahath Zerah Shammah and Mizzah They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath
verses.literalPt: E estes foram os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá; estes foram os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אָהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת־ עֲנָ֛ה בַּת־ צִבְע֖וֹן אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת־ יְעִישׁ וְאֶת־ יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־ קֹֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hā·yū bə·nê ’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh ḇaṯ- ‘ă·nāh baṯ- ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw wat·tê·leḏ lə·‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- yə·ʿīš wə·’eṯ- ya‘·lām wə·’eṯ- qō·raḥ
verses.literal: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon whom she bore to Esau Jeush Jalam and Korah
verses.literalPt: E estes foram os filhos de Aolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná, filho de Zibeão; ela teve de Esaú: Jeús, Jalão e Coré.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכ֣וֹר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אוֹמָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ḇə·nê- ‘ê·śāw bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·p̄az bə·ḵō·wr ‘ê·śāw ’al·lūp̄ tê·mān ’al·lūp̄ ’ō·w·mār ’al·lūp̄ ṣə·p̄ōw ’al·lūp̄ qə·naz
verses.literal: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau Chiefs Teman . . . Omar . . . Zepho . . . Kenaz
verses.literalPt: Estes são os príncipes dos filhos de Esaú: os filhos de Elifaz, o primogênito de Esaú, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Omar, o príncipe Zefô, o príncipe Quenaz.

verses.original: אַלּֽוּף־ קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄- qō·raḥ ’al·lūp̄ ga‘·tām ’al·lūp̄ ‘ă·mā·lêq ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ĕ·lî·p̄az bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’êl·leh bə·nê ‘ā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Korah Gatam and Amalek They are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom and they are the grandsons of Adah
verses.literalPt: O príncipe Coré, o príncipe Gaetã, o príncipe Amaleque; estes são os príncipes de Elifaz na terra de Edom; estes são os filhos de Ada.

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־ עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֙חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh bə·nê rə·‘ū·’êl ben- ‘ê·śāw ’al·lūp̄ na·ḥaṯ ’al·lūp̄ ze·raḥ ’al·lūp̄ šam·māh ’al·lūp̄ miz·zāh ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê rə·‘ū·’êl bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’êl·leh bə·nê ḇā·śə·maṯ ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel Chiefs Nahath Zerah . . . Shammah . . . and Mizzah They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath
verses.literalPt: E estes são os filhos de Reuel, filhos de Esaú: o príncipe Naate, o príncipe Zerá, o príncipe Samá, o príncipe Mizá; estes são os príncipes de Reuel, na terra de Edom; estes são os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת־ עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh bə·nê ’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw ’al·lūp̄ yə·‘ūš ’al·lūp̄ ya‘·lām ’al·lūp̄ qō·raḥ ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh baṯ- ‘ă·nāh ’ê·šeṯ ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah Chiefs Jeush Jalam . . . and Korah They are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah the daughter of Anah
verses.literalPt: E estes são os filhos de Aolibama, mulher de Esaú: o príncipe Jeús, o príncipe Jalão, o príncipe Coré; estes são os príncipes de Aolibama, filha de Aná, mulher de Esaú.

verses.original: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- ‘ê·śāw wə·’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê·hem hū ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: All these are the sons of Esau (that is Edom and they were their chiefs
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Esaú, e estes são seus príncipes: Ele é Edom.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ שֵׂעִיר֙ הַחֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֥וֹן וַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- śê·‘îr ha·ḥō·rî yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ lō·w·ṭān wə·šō·w·ḇāl wə·ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn wa·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: These are the sons of Seir the Horite who were living in the land Lotan Shobal Zibeon Anah
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Seir, horeu, moradores daquela terra: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão e Aná,

verses.original: וְדִשׁ֥וֹן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏi·šō·wn wə·’ê·ṣer wə·ḏî·šān ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ha·ḥō·rî bə·nê śê·‘îr bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Dishon Ezer and Dishan They are the chiefs of the Horites the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom
verses.literalPt: Disom, Eser e Disã; estes são os príncipes dos horeus, filhos de Seir, na terra de Edom.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהֵימָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- lō·w·ṭān ḥō·rî wə·hê·mām wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ lō·w·ṭān tim·nā‘
verses.literal: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam Timna was Lotan’s sister
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Lotã foram Hori e Homã; e a irmã de Lotã era Timna.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּמָנַ֖חַת וְעֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפ֖וֹ וְאוֹנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh bə·nê šō·w·ḇāl ‘al·wān ū·mā·na·ḥaṯ wə·‘ê·ḇāl šə·p̄ōw wə·’ō·w·nām
verses.literal: These are the sons of Shobal Alvan Manahath Ebal Shepho and Onam
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Sobal: Alvã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefô e Onã.

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ צִבְע֖וֹן וְאַיָּ֣ה וַעֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת־ הַיֵּמִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּרְעֹת֥וֹ אֶת־ הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים לְצִבְע֥וֹן אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ḇə·nê- ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn wə·’ay·yāh wa·‘ă·nāh hū ‘ă·nāh ’ă·šer mā·ṣā ’eṯ- hay·yê·mim bam·miḏ·bār bir·‘ō·ṯōw ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·mō·rîm lə·ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: These are the sons of Zibeon Aiah and Anah This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon
verses.literalPt: E estes são os filhos de Zibeão: Aiá e Aná; este é o Aná que achou as fontes termais no deserto, quando apascentava os jumentos de Zibeão, seu pai.

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת־ עֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ḇə·nê- ‘ă·nāh di·šōn wə·’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh baṯ- ‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: These are the children of Anah Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah
verses.literalPt: E estes são os filhos de Aná: Disom e Aolibama, a filha de Aná.

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh bə·nê ḏî·šān ḥem·dān wə·’eš·bān wə·yiṯ·rān ū·ḵə·rān
verses.literal: These are the sons of Dishon Hemdan Eshban Ithran and Cheran
verses.literalPt: E estes são os filhos de Disã: Hendã, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־ אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן וַעֲקָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh bə·nê- ’ê·ṣer bil·hān wə·za·‘ă·wān wa·‘ă·qān
verses.literal: These are the sons of Ezer Bilhan Zaavan and Akan
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã e Acã.

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- ḏî·šān ‘ūṣ wa·’ă·rān
verses.literal: These are the sons of Dishan Uz and Aran
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַחֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לוֹטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שׁוֹבָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְע֖וֹן אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ha·ḥō·rî ’al·lūp̄ lō·w·ṭān ’al·lūp̄ šō·w·ḇāl ’al·lūp̄ ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn ’al·lūp̄ ‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: These are the chiefs of the Horites Chiefs Lotan . . . Shobal . . . Zibeon . . . Anah
verses.literalPt: Estes são os príncipes dos horeus: o príncipe Lotã, o príncipe Sobal, o príncipe Zibeão, o príncipe Aná.

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ di·šōn ’al·lūp̄ ’ê·ṣer ’al·lūp̄ dî·šān ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ha·ḥō·rî lə·’al·lu·p̄ê·hem bə·’e·reṣ śê·‘îr
verses.literal: Dishon Ezer . . . and Dishan They are the chiefs of the Horites according to their divisions in the land of Seir
verses.literalPt: O príncipe Disom, o príncipe Eser, o príncipe Disã: estes são os príncipes dos horeus segundo os seus principados na terra de Seir.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer mā·lə·ḵū bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm lip̄·nê mə·lāḵ- me·leḵ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: E estes são os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei algum sobre os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּאֱד֔וֹם בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן־ בְּע֑וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lōḵ be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm be·la‘ ben- bə·‘ō·wr wə·šêm ‘î·rōw din·hā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom the name of his city was Dinhabah
verses.literalPt: Reinou, pois, em Edom Bela, filho de Beor, e o nome da sua cidade foi Dinabá.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־ זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ bā·la‘ way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw yō·w·ḇāḇ ben- ze·raḥ mib·bā·ṣə·rāh
verses.literal: When Bela died Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E morreu Bela; e Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ yō·w·ḇāḇ way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw ḥu·šām mê·’e·reṣ hat·tê·mā·nî
verses.literal: When Jobab died Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E morreu Jobabe; e Husão, da terra dos temanitas, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־ בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־ מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עֲוִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ḥu·šām way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw hă·ḏaḏ ben- bə·ḏaḏ ham·mak·keh ’eṯ- miḏ·yān biś·ḏêh mō·w·’āḇ wə·šêm ‘î·rōw ‘ă·wîṯ
verses.literal: When Husham died Hadad son of Bedad who defeated Midian in the country of Moab reigned in his place And the name of his city was Avith
verses.literalPt: E morreu Husão, e em seu lugar reinou Hadade, filho de Bedade, o que feriu a Midiã, no campo de Moabe; e o nome da sua cidade foi Avite.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ hă·ḏāḏ way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw śam·lāh mim·maś·rê·qāh
verses.literal: When Hadad died Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E morreu Hadade; e Samlá de Masreca reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ śam·lāh way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw šā·’ūl mê·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ han·nā·hār
verses.literal: When Samlah died Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E morreu Samlá; e Saul de Reobote, junto ao rio, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ šā·’ūl way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw ba·‘al ḥā·nān ben- ‘aḵ·bō·wr
verses.literal: When Shaul died Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E morreu Saul; e Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּמָת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּוֹר֒ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־ מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ba·‘al ḥā·nān ben- ‘aḵ·bō·wr way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw hă·ḏar wə·šêm ‘î·rōw pā·‘ū wə·šêm ’iš·tōw mə·hê·ṭaḇ·’êl baṯ- maṭ·rêḏ baṯ mê zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died Hadad reigned in his place His city was named Pau and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred the daughter of Me-zahab
verses.literalPt: E morreu Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor; e Hadar reinou em seu lugar, e o nome de sua cidade foi Pau; e o nome de sua mulher foi Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Me-Zaabe.

verses.original: וְ֠אֵלֶּה שְׁמ֞וֹת אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לִמְקֹמֹתָ֖ם בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ ’al·lū·p̄ê ‘ê·śāw lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām lim·qō·mō·ṯām biš·mō·ṯām ’al·lūp̄ tim·nā‘ ’al·lūp̄ ‘al·wāh ’al·lūp̄ yə·ṯêṯ
verses.literal: These are the names of Esau’s chiefs according to their families and regions by their names Chiefs Timna . . . Alvah . . . Jetheth
verses.literalPt: E estes são os nomes dos príncipes de Esaú, segundo as suas gerações, segundo os seus lugares, com os seus nomes: o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Alva, o príncipe Jetete,

verses.original: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ ’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh ’al·lūp̄ ’ê·lāh ’al·lūp̄ pî·nōn
verses.literal: Oholibamah . . . Elah . . . Pinon
verses.literalPt: O príncipe Aolibama, o príncipe Ela, o príncipe Pinom,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ qə·naz ’al·lūp̄ tê·mān ’al·lūp̄ miḇ·ṣār
verses.literal: Kenaz . . . Teman . . . Mibzar
verses.literalPt: O príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה׀ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֗וֹם לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ maḡ·dî·’êl ’al·lūp̄ ‘î·rām ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm lə·mō·šə·ḇō·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām hū ‘ê·śāw ’ă·ḇî ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Magdiel . . . and Iram These were the chiefs of Edom according to their settlements in the land they possessed Esau was the father of the Edomites
verses.literalPt: O príncipe Magdiel, o príncipe Irã: estes são os príncipes de Edom, segundo as suas habitações, na terra da sua possessão. Este é Esaú, pai de Edom.
